senses.gloss: ch.<cite ref="S01402">same</cite> <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Joel 1:7">Targ. Joel I, 7</cite>; a. e.—Part. pass. <he>קָלִיף</he>.
units: <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Deuteronomy 14:11">Targ. Y. Deut. XIV, 11</cite>.—

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 82">Gen. R. s. 82</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Jeremiah 49:10">Jer. XLIX, 10</cite>) <he>קַלְפִית בצלייה</he> Ar. (ed. <he>קליפת בצלים</he>, ref. to <cite ref="Obadiah 1:6">Ob. I, 6</cite>, corr. acc.) I stripped the onions (laid bare Esau’s corruption); <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 332">Yalk. Jer. 332</cite> <he>קְלִיפִית</he> (not <he>קליפות</he>); Yalk. Chr. 1073 (corr. acc.).
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 95:4">Gen. R. s. 95</cite>, end, v. <cite ref="B00313"><he>בּוּצְלָא</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 3:4:2">Cant. R. to III, 4</cite> (expl. <he>חשפי שבל</he>, <cite ref="Isaiah 47:2">Is. XLVII, 2</cite>) <he>קְלוֹפִי סובלתא דנהרא</he> (v. <cite ref="U00325"><he>שׁוּבַּלְתָּא</he></cite>) lay bare (the bed of) the current of the river (dig channels to divert the river from its course).
<cite ref="Beitzah 14b:3">Bets. 14ᵇ</cite> <he>קָלִיף וכ׳</he>, v. <cite ref="R00319"><he>צִיהֲרָא</he></cite>; a. e.—
<cite ref="Bava Batra 4b">B. Bath. 4ᵇ</cite>, v. <cite ref="S01748"><he>קְפַל</he> II</cite>.
Targ. O. Gen. XXX, 37 (Y. קְלֵף Pe.). Ib. 38.
Targ. II Kings XVIII, 16; a. e.—Part. pass. מְקַלַּף peeling, flaky.
<cite ref="Onkelos Exodus 16:14">Targ. O. Ex. XVI, 14</cite> (h. text <he>מחספס</he>).—
<cite ref="Beitzah 13b:9">Bets. 13ᵇ</cite> <he>מְקַלְּפָא ליה וכ׳</he> his wife husked (barley) for him by the cupfuls.
<cite ref="Chullin 62b:3-6">Ḥull. 62ᵇ</cite> <he>לא … מְקַלַּף וכ׳</he> its craw could not be peeled.

<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Leviticus 11:13">Targ. Y. Lev. XI, 13</cite> <he>מִקְּלִיף</he> (not <he>מַקְ׳</he>).—Ḥull. l. c. <he>לא מִקְּלִיף וכ׳</he> could be peeled with a knife only. Y. Snh. IV, 22ᵇ top, v. <cite ref="M02766"><he>מַרְקוֹעַ</he> II</cite>.

<cite ref="Moed Katan 13b:9">M. Kat. 13ᵇ</cite> <he>כגון דמִיקַּלְּפָּן</he> when the grains are husked; <he>אי לאו … מִיקַּלְּפָא</he> if they had not steeped them in water, the husking could not have been done (differ. in Ms. M., v. Rabb. D. S. a. l.); a. e.
